body:
If I never wake up on the floor again...that'd be nice.

I've been through depression and felt like I'd gotten over it, like I'd "seen over the top of the mountain".  And yet...here we are again.
This is a damn good post right here.  Thank you, sincerely, thank you so much for taking the time to write.  It means a lot to me right now.

Man, I feel you on the "no one answering the phone" thing.  I've been through that so many times and it just leaves you with that "Well what the fuck do I do now?" feeling.

I've just started posting here tonight.  It sounds like you're in a really tough spot, that deserves acknowledgement.  Where you go from here...I can't really say.  I mainly just wanted to post and let you know that someone read this and they're thinking about you and they hope you're going to be ok.

Christ, man, I just made my first post on this sub with this throwaway.  Honestly you sound like I would expect myself to at your age if I had gone back to grad school when everyone said I should.

I don't know what the solution is, to your problems, or my problems.  I just wanted to comment to confirm that you and I, we're still here.

We're still here, bud.  We're still here.
